observedFacts.statement: Two passenger vehicles (dark gray Vehicle A and silver Vehicle B) are situated within an urban intersection with contacting or immediately adjacent front corners.
Debris consisting of shattered headlamp plastic and bumper fragments is concentrated on the asphalt directly beneath the contact point of both vehicles.
Vehicle A (dark gray) shows crush deformation to its front-right wing, fractured front bumper cover, and shattered headlight unit.
Vehicle B (silver) exhibits lateral scraping and compression along its front-left wing, wheel arch, and adjoining panel seam.
Driver reported travelling straight through the intersection when the other vehicle entered their path.

inferredDynamics.statement: The relative positions and damage geometries are consistent with intersecting approach trajectories at an angle.
inferredDynamics.rationale: Debris field concentration and matching deformation heights support an intersection collision.

inferredDynamics.statement: Pre-impact vehicle speeds appear to have been low to moderate.
inferredDynamics.rationale: Passenger cabin survival spaces are undeformed, A-pillars intact, and wheel hubs remain in primary alignment.

visibleDamage.description: Bumper fascia torn, front-right fender crushed inward, right headlamp assembly destroyed.
Body crease across front-left wing, paint transfer/scuffing extending toward driver door seam.
